project: Conan — v4.3: HUD/UX expansion (Plan widget + observability + UI lifts)
description: v4.3 expands the Tauri terminal-wrapper's HUD/UX: land the finished context-accuracy fixes and make the /context auto-refresh adaptive (observer-effect aware); add a conditional Plan tab (from TodoWrite/ExitPlanMode/build-loop) and a Skills tab (VS Code-extensions-style, from SKILL.md frontmatter); add a read-only Settings surface mirroring Claude's /config; and a run of UI lifts — real terminal tabs (drop the Term dropdown), a bottom status bar (cwd / branch / gateway, moved out of the HUD), a View > Theme submenu that drives Conan's app theme AND mirrors Claude's terminal /theme, a context-pressure action bar (Compact -> /handoff in the correlated pty), and flush/panel-native widget content (no card chrome). Backend before UI; build stays green at every story. Source: docs/v4.3-backlog.md. Resolved decisions (2026-05-27): the US-013 follow-up folded as the first story (not pre-committed); chrome = bottom bar; Settings = read-only only this loop; Theme = include the Claude /theme mirror.

userStories.title: Land the context-accuracy fixes (1M window + /context auto-refresh + hook token + sidecar-test)
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want the Context widget to be accurate on 1M-context sessions and to stay current, so the HUD reflects reality.
acceptanceCriteria: resolveContextWindow returns a 1M window when: the model slug carries a 1m marker, OR a sibling session on the SAME base model reports 1m, OR measured used tokens exceed the 200k default; otherwise 200k (unit-tested in scripts/test-context.mjs)
A 1M-context session (e.g. claude-opus-4-7[1m]) shows the correct low % in the Context widget, not ~99%
autoRefreshContextOnStop injects /context on the Stop hook, throttled per session, and is a no-op when the session has no live correlated pty or when CONAN_CONTEXT_AUTOREFRESH=0
scripts/hooks/send-event.mjs resolves the auth token from CONAN_DATA_DIR so events from the Tauri-app-spawned gateway are not 401'd
scripts/test-sidecar.mjs uses a parent-held stdin pipe (not /dev/null) so the EOF watchdog doesn't cause a false health-check failure
npm test passes all suites
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build is clean
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (a 1M-context session shows the correct low % in the Context widget)
userStories.notes: This is the finished-but-uncommitted US-013 follow-up, folded in as the first story (per the 2026-05-27 decision) — verify the behaviors hold and the tree is green; the runner commits it. The em-dash re-encoding noise in the old prd.json is superseded by this v4.3 rewrite. Suggested skills: automate-browser (confirm the Context % in the running UI).

userStories.title: Make the /context auto-refresh adaptive (delta-triggered, not every turn)
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I don't want self-measurement to inflate or burn my context, so /context should refresh only when context has likely moved a lot.
acceptanceCriteria: The auto-refresh replaces the fixed once-per-Stop cadence with a delta trigger: it injects /context only after cumulative output since the last capture (PostToolUse tool_response sizes + assistant message length) crosses a meaningful threshold
A hard floor (>= the existing min spacing) AND a ceiling are enforced, so tiny turns don't refresh and a slow session still refreshes eventually
Manual refresh and passive capture remain always-available cheap paths; CONAN_CONTEXT_AUTOREFRESH=0 still disables auto-refresh
The Context widget's live face notes that refreshing consumes context (honest cost)
Behavior of the delta trigger is unit-covered (threshold/floor/ceiling)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill
userStories.notes: Observer-effect fix (a /context dump is ~4-6k tokens). Refines US-001's autoRefreshContextOnStop. Settled: a hidden/background window can't report the visible session's context (different process). Long-term alternative noted in the backlog: compute the breakdown ourselves and drop the inject. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Backend: derive per-session plan-state from the event stream + expose a route
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the active session's plan available to the UI, derived from hook events already on the wire.
acceptanceCriteria: Reduce the persisted event stream into per-session plan-state: latest-wins TodoWrite todos ([{content, status, activeForm}]) + the last ExitPlanMode plan markdown
Expose GET /api/claude/sessions/:id/plan (token-gated) that rehydrates from the persisted event table so a reconnect restores the current plan
isActive is true when the session has a non-empty TodoWrite list with at least one non-completed item, OR a recent ExitPlanMode plan, OR an active build loop; false otherwise
Reducer logic is unit-tested
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: No new capture — the forwarder already passes the full tool_input. Precedence: live TodoWrite -> ExitPlanMode seed -> build-loop. See docs/v4.3-backlog.md Plan-widget section.

PlanWidget renders the checklist (per-item status icon + a progress count) and/or the proposed-plan markdown; falls back to the build-loop tasks feed when no interactive plan is live
A conditional 4th HUD tab (Plan) is shown/enabled only when isActive, and greyed/disabled/hidden when there's no active plan or all TodoWrite items are completed

userStories.title: Mirror the theme choice into Claude's terminal /theme
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want the in-terminal text theme to harmonize with the app theme.
acceptanceCriteria: On a Conan theme change, the choice is mirrored into Claude Code's terminal /theme via the reliable mechanism (research config-write vs keystroke-inject; choose the non-fragile one and document why)
The terminal-theme control is presented as a separate, clearly-labeled menu group ('Terminal text theme') so the two theme layers aren't conflated
The mirror is a safe no-op when its precondition isn't met (no live pty for the inject path, or a missing config path for the file path) and that state is reflected in the UI
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill
userStories.notes: Decision 2026-05-27: include the mirror. Mechanism research required; relates to the keystroke-injection path in src/terminal/index.ts. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Context-pressure action bar (Compact -> /handoff in the correlated pty)
userStories.description: As a Conan user, when context is filling up I want a quick way to checkpoint and compact the session.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Context HUD tab, a bottom action bar appears conditionally when ctxPct >= 80% (matching the destructive-ring threshold), with two actions: Cancel and Compact
Cancel hides the bar until a higher threshold is crossed (no nagging every render)
Compact injects /handoff (then optionally /compact) into the correlated pty via the existing keystroke-injection path; it is disabled/hidden when the session has no live correlated pty
The action is labeled so it's clear it runs in the terminal session and that HANDOFF.md is written by the session (not by Conan)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (bar appears past threshold; Cancel hides it; Compact disabled with no live pty; light + dark)
userStories.notes: Decided: write HANDOFF.md, not CLAUDE.md (CLAUDE.md auto-loads into every future session). Conan can't author the handoff itself — it must inject so the session does. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: UI lift: flush, panel-native HUD content (no card chrome)
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want the HUD tabs to read as one continuous panel, not cards floating inside it.
acceptanceCriteria: Flatten the Context + Usage section containers in Widgets.tsx: no rounded corners, no box-borders, no inset background panels around sub-sections; keep the data viz (progress ring, stacked bars, category dots)
Sections are separated by full-width border-t dividers (edge-to-edge), like the PulseChart compact rule; no border radius anywhere in the tab body
The Pulse tab uses the flush/no-radius treatment too (render compact or equivalent) so Context | Usage | Pulse | Plan | Skills share one continuous surface
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (all tabs read as one panel a la Linear; light + dark)
userStories.notes: Run last so it harmonizes the new tabs too. Reference: PulseChart compact rule (PulseChart.tsx:103-108). Suggested skills: automate-browser.
